description: This file contains the service layer for an e-commerce chatbot backend, implementing business logic such as chat response generation, product search, recommendations, and question answering. It imports models, external data, and configurations, and exposes several functions for external use.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] generate_chat_reply(messages: List[Message], context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Generates a chatbot reply based on a sequence of messages and optional context, performing mock intent detection.

methods.name: List[Product] search_products(query: str, limit: int = 10, filters: Optional[dict] = None)
methods.description: Mock product search returning products matching the query in title or description.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] recommend_products(recent_ids: Optional[List[str]] = None, max_results: int = 6)
methods.description: Provides product recommendations based on recent view history or top popular items.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] answer_question(question: str, product_ids: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Answers user questions with mock heuristics, including basic policy keyword recognition and related product info.
